data.title: Tom Lee's BitMine Is Close to Owning 5% of All ETH: What Happens to BMNR When It Does? - BitMine Immersio
data.description: BitMine aims to own 5% of Ethereum supply, raising questions on future demand and strategy. The treasury company has already staked 5 million ETH, worth $257 million annually.
data.author: Khyathi Dalal
